exposure: Mothers still ill and on therapy postpartum
cohort: 35 pregnant women diagnosed with malignant tumors during pregnancy
finding: The study found that continuing pregnancy as long as possible in women with non-progressing tumors was associated with better maternal and infant outcomes.
mod_finding: Most fetuses in the study were delivered by cesarean section (CS) before term.
birth_weight: High birthweight was associated with good infant outcome
